Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. I couldn't make this change because I couldn't find the Asset Name column. FleetTable has 6 columns, but my tools can't read the header text or cell textbox names, so I can't map "Asset Name" to a column. I tried the textbox name `AssetName` and it doesn't exist in the table. I made no changes to the report.

If you tell me either the 0-based column index (0 is the leftmost column) or the name of a textbox in that column, I'll set its width to 2in. If you can open the report in Report Builder, the textbox name is in the Properties pane when you click the Asset Name cell.

Widening that column to 2in will also make the table wider than its current 6in outer width, since the other columns stay as they are. I can adjust those too if you want the table to keep its size.
